title: org clock report JSON output
description: Schema for the JSON output of 'org clock report --format json'.

label.description: Label for this clock report row (entry title, date, tag, etc.).

file.description: Path to the org file. Present when group_by=entry.

effort_minutes.description: Optional :EFFORT: estimate in minutes when present on the entry.

variance_minutes.description: Signed variance in minutes (minutes - effort_minutes) when :EFFORT: is present.
